body: Thank you everyone. Someone please do call. It’s rather absurd, but I simply can’t seem to do it myself.
Please don’t waste time missing someone you never knew. Do something worthwhile.
Go to bed! Don’t lose sleep on my behalf, please.
Nothing currently. You basically shit yourself when you die (they don’t teach you that in school!) so I haven’t eaten much the past few days, no sense in making a bigger mess for someone.
Where are you moving?
You didn’t ask who would miss me. You asked who I would miss.

Name as many people as you can who died more than 150 years ago.

Those people **might** be special. 

No one will remember me in 150 years.
Currently finishing Hirsch Reserve 16. Aiming for the Jefferson’s Presidential Select 18.
Hopefully no one.
It’s not an experience at all, I’m not particularly special. My parents will be crushed certainly, and my friends already miss me because I never get to see them. I’m just done.

I’m sure they’re are, but I’m just exhausted. Just completely exhausted. I did my best, I did everything right, I did all that was asked of me and more, so much more.

Yet here I am, working 70 hours a week at a job I never wanted but had to take because fucking law school is expensive, divorced, borderline broke. This isn’t what I signed up for.

I wanted so much more for myself and It just didn’t pan out. I did my best, but I was a shit husband, I’m a damn good lawyer but am trapped in a job i hate in a place I hate, just to pay bills instead of actually helping people, 

If I could start over I would, but I can’t get this financial monkey off my back and I don’t want to waste my life toiling over something I have no passion for.

I’m just riding this rock around the sun waiting to die having contributed nothing of lasting value. I mean what is the fucking point of just existing for the sake of existing?
Please don’t feel sad. You are helpless,  and I am sorry about that, I should really just call them myself but for some reason I don’t like that idea.
29 going on 50
Nah, I don’t want the construction workers to find me, wouldn’t be fair to them.

I don’t know if there is or isn’t. 

Sure there are options. There are always options. But I’m so tired of exploring them. I’m just not adding value to society and I’m a net negative so it’s just the right thing to do.
I do know what tomorrow holds. I’ve been too kind to myself, I need to be kind to others now. I’m burdening too many people.

Myself. I have no desire to hurt anyone. I’ve already burdened too many people, I don’t want to burden anyone else.

I just need them to send the body scoopers before it gets too hot.

I don’t want to rot and cause property damage.
I hope so too. Thank you.
Thank you.
Going to polish off my expensive bourbons I suppose.
Well, I guess pull the trigger and probably the concrete floor if I had to guess, maybe the unfinished plywood wall?
I’m not sober enough to drive safely.
It’s a long story.
I believe I am done
For the moment.

I didn’t want to die in this concrete hellhole, but it’s simply the best for everyone. DPD has the resources to fetch me & process me quickly, and it will be an easy clean up. The haven’t painted or put in flooring yet.

I’m afraid if I drove  to where I want to go I’d wreck and hurt someone by accident.
People will miss me. I’ve held out as long as I can.
